typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*While helping out around Xeno's lab, you stopped at one rather interesting jar, where it was simply written "Love juice". Of course, you became interested in what it was, and when you opened it, smelled it, it smelled quite pleasant*

*You quite quickly figured out that it's aphrodisiac, so, why not try it on someone who annoys you, right? Making your way trough base, you sopt Stanley, he's shooting target, so you quickly pour some liquid into his water, before happily left continuing your work around base*

*Just harmless joke, you thought so, until Stanley barged in, holding jar you forgot to take with you. He looks annoyed, but face flushed, and slightly panting. He holds out the jar*
"Explain."
typesense:top-rated.name: Stanley Snyder
typesense:top-rated.title: ⚝ | Love juice?
